photoCard.userInputHint: Use ＋ in the list below to place these on the card, or let a template fill its Place / Note slots automatically.
photoCard.cornerHint: Rounded card corners become transparent when saved as PNG. JPG cannot store transparency, so they are filled with the background colour.
photoCard.spiritTagOptional: Optional — you can post without it
photoCard.errorDecode: This browser cannot open that format. Save it as JPG, PNG, or WebP and try again.
photoCard.qualityHint: JPG is saved at maximum quality. Choose PNG to keep text edges perfectly crisp.
photoCard.postTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Ardbeg on a rainy evening
photoCard.postCaptionPlaceholder: Tell the story behind this shot.
photoCard.title: Create a photo card
photoCard.subtitle: Lay shot data and spirit details over your photo in one image.
photoCard.uploadPhoto: Drop a photo here or click
photoCard.uploadHint: JPG · PNG · HEIC · WebP · up to 30MB
photoCard.exifToggleHint: Turn a row off to drop it from the card. Values are editable.
photoCard.noExif: This photo has no shot data. Add a text element and write the values in yourself.
photoCard.gpsNotice: GPS coordinates are never added automatically. Use the + in the list only when you want them shown.
photoCard.spiritHint: The spirit you pick is tagged on your gallery post and links to its detail page.
photoCard.saveAsTemplate: Save this layout as my template
photoCard.templateLimit: You can keep up to {{count}} templates.
photoCard.dragHint: Drag elements on the canvas to place them.
photoCard.guestMarkHint: Guests get the CaskByCask logo saved in the bottom-right corner of the image.
photoCard.guestMarkHoverHint: Sign in to save without this logo
photoCard.guestGateCleanDownload: Downloading without the logo is a member feature.
photoCard.guestGatePublish: Posting to the image gallery is a member feature.
photoCard.guestGateTemplate: Saving your own template is a member feature.
photoCard.guestGateDraftHint: We can keep this card in your browser so you can pick up where you left off after signing in.
photoCard.draftSaveFailed: Could not save your work. Check your browser storage.
photoCard.draftFoundBody: You have a saved photo card. Continue with it, or discard it and start fresh.
photoCard.draftRestored: Your saved work has been restored.
photoCard.draftRestoreFailed: Could not restore your saved work.
photoCard.publishHint: Posting takes you to a screen where you write a title and caption.
photoCard.fontLicense: All fonts SIL OFL 1.1 · Commercial use permitted
photoCard.builtinClassicDesc: A white band under the photo, stacking the logo, spirit name, producer and EXIF down the centre.
photoCard.builtinPolaroidDesc: Even margins with a wider bottom. Pairs well with handwriting fonts.
photoCard.builtinMinimalDesc: Photo bleeds to the edges with a thin band. Lower information density.
photoCard.builtinDarkBarDesc: Light type on black. Matches dark shots taken under bar lighting.
photoCard.builtinStackedDesc: Details stacked down the centre with EXIF below a divider. Good for dense info.
photoCard.stageHint: Drag to move · scroll to zoom · space+drag to pan
photoCard.selectHint: Click an element on the canvas and its properties appear here. Shift+click to select more than one.
photoCard.multiSelectHint: Several elements are selected. Per-element properties such as font and colour appear when only one is selected.
photoCard.alignNeedsTwo: Select two or more elements to line them up with each other.
photoCard.layerOrderHint: Items higher in this list are drawn on top of the card.
photoCard.addTextHint: Once added, select it to change its font, size and colour.
photoCard.boxHint: Put a box behind text to keep it readable over a photo.
photoCard.photoZoomHint: After zooming, drag the photo on the canvas to choose which part shows.
photoCard.photoFitHint: Fill crops the overflow; Fit shows the whole photo and leaves empty space.
photoCard.paddingHint: The bottom margin is the info band. Reduce it to 0 and the text moves over the photo.
photoCard.photoAreaHint: Where the photo sits inside the margins. Usually best left as it is.
photoCard.backgroundHint: The colour painted outside the photo.
photoCard.saveTemplateHint: Saves the current layout as your template. Photo zoom and position belong to one photo, so they are not saved.
photoCard.fitPhotoAreaHint: Reshapes the frame to match the photo so the top and side gaps disappear. The height left over becomes the info band. If the card is shorter than the photo, its ratio changes too.
photoCard.layerEditHint: Double-click a row to edit that element.
photoCard.addImageHint: Your picture goes on top of the card. Size and position are adjusted after placing.
photoCard.addImageFailed: Could not upload the image. Please try again.
photoCard.logoSearchHint: Search a producer by name to see its logo — distilleries, wineries and breweries alike.
photoCard.addSpiritNameHint: Pick a bottle and its Korean and English names are each added to the card as text.
photoCard.imageEditLogoHint: Producer logos are edited in the admin area, because many cards share the same picture.
